messages:
Omar H: Heads-up — flights changed, need someone to cover primary tonight 22:00-02:00 UTC. I'm currently primary. There was a eu-west-1 latency blip around 21:40 that touched customer-facing traffic, so prefer someone comfortable with the eu runbook. @Ashley M? :wave:

Ashley M: I can take 22:30-01:00 but I have a 00:30 call. I could do 22:30-00:30 and then hand off to Kevin if that works.

Kevin L: I can shadow from 23:45-02:15 and pick up primary at 00:30. Happy to accept the midnight-to-02:15 stretch.

Omar H: Awesome — goal is contiguous coverage. Plan: Ashley 22:30-00:30, Kevin 00:30-02:15. Can someone run the oncall transfer and paste the runbook link here? I'll also dump quick context notes.

SRE Oncall: Runbook pointer: https://redwood.runbooks/latency/eu-west-1-handling — includes rollback steps, KV-cache flush guidance, and fallback model variant toggles. Metric to watch: rps/latency_p50_eu-west1.

incident-bot: Pager event INC-2026-345 triggered 2026-03-15T21:40Z (eu-west-1 latency). Auto-acknowledged by Omar H. Current paging target: Omar H (primary).

Ashley M: I'll take 22:30-00:30. Notes for handoff: prefix cache warm-up may be stale after the spike; watch cache hit ratio and the fallback-model flag. Alert threshold we care about: p50 > 300ms for 5m.

Kevin L: I'll take 00:30-02:15. Omar, please add any open deploy threads or recent log links so I can triage quickly if it pops.

Omar H: Added context: deploys today — https://confluence.redwood/deploys/2026-03-15 ; recent logs (21:35-21:50 window) — https://s3.redwood/logs/eu-west-1/2026-03-15/21-35_to_21-50.log ; rollback note: model-variant v2b can be toggled via ops-console.

Ashley M: Running the swap via opsbot now:
```
/oncall transfer --from "Omar H" --to "Ashley M" --start 2026-03-15T22:30Z --end 2026-03-16T00:30Z --note "flight swap; leaving watchlist"
```

incident-bot: Oncall change recorded. New primary 22:30-00:30: Ashley M. Secondary/Shadow: Kevin L. Omar H remains shadow until 22:30.

Kevin L: Can someone confirm PagerDuty schedule for the group 'Redwood-Inference-SRE' was updated? I don't have perms to edit schedules.

SRE Oncall: Confirmed — PD schedule updated: ASHLEY is primary 22:30-00:30, KEVIN primary 00:30-02:15. Pager policies and escalation paths remain unchanged.

Omar H: Thanks all. Final sticky notes: check KV cache prefixes, enable fallback-variant if latency reappears, and if we escalate tag #inc-ops and call the on-call phone list. Leaving a short note in handoff doc for both of you. :thumbsup:

Ashley M: Got it. I'll post a short recap in #incidents after midnight and DM Kevin to confirm the handoff.

Kevin L: Copy. I'll check the runbook and metrics dashboard at 00:20 to warm up. See you both. :)
